subject: Endgame accelerator: trial extension & usage allowance
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Kim <alex.kim@secureai.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Endgame accelerator: initial proposal

Alex / SecureAI team —

Great conversation yesterday. To give you the runway to finish the PoC and accelerate to a production decision this quarter, we proponed an "endgame accelerator" offer:

- 4-week free trial extension for the production cluster (no billing during extension)
- $12,000 usage allowance that can be applied to first invoice after conversion
- 8 hours of white-glove integration support (senior infra + one dev uplift session)

I've attached a short MAP showing milestones and success criteria (attachment: proposed-MAP.pdf).

Vanessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

----
Attachment: proposed-MAP.pdf (1.2MB)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Endgame accelerator: initial proposal

Thanks Vanessa — good framing. A couple of quick internal notes before we take something formal to Alex:

- Can we tighten the ask to $10k usage allowance instead of $12k? Q2 runway is tight and finance prefers round numbers.
- Add explicit success criteria we can measure (query latency under 300ms for top 3 endpoints; 80% of test prompts within target quality).
- Request Marissa confirm the 8 hours of support and what that looks like (onboarding vs dev uplift).

Ben / Rishi: can you weigh in on the $10k vs $12k call? If we can approve $10k on the spot I think this closes this week.

Grace
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

----

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Endgame accelerator: initial proposal

Grace / team —

I can authorize up to $10,000 usage allowance as a one-time conversion credit for SecureAI conditional on two items:

1) We update the MSA with a one-time amendment that clarifies the credit application (finance needs the amendment to apply to invoice).
2) Marissa confirms scope of the 8 hours and that it's non-recurring (we don't want ongoing committed hours without a paid work order).

If those two boxes are checked, finance signs off and we can push a DocuSign amendment to SecureAI today.

Rishi
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Endgame accelerator: initial proposal

Grace / team —

Confirmed: 8 hours of support is fine as a one-time onboarding block. Plan I'm proposing:
- 2 hours kickoff + architecture review (senior infra)
- 4 hours dedicated pairing sessions with SecureAI engineers to wire up KV cache + batching tuning
- 2 hours post-onboarding tuning & handoff to CS success manager

I'll record the sessions as deliverables in the MAP and include a short checklist for handover. No ongoing SLA changes required.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@secureai.com>, SecureAI PM <pm@secureai.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T12:31:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Endgame accelerator — approved (4-week extension + $10k)

Alex —

Thanks again for the quick cadence. We're prepared to move forward with a final, simplified offer to help SecureAI finish the PoC and accelerate to a production decision this quarter:

- 4-week extension to the existing trial environment (no billing during extension)
- $10,000 one-time usage credit to be applied to the first invoice post-conversion
- 8 hours of one-time onboarding/integration support (detailed plan attached)

Conditions / next steps:
1) We'll send a one-page amendment to the MSA for signature (DocuSign link below). Finance requires the amendment to apply the credit.
2) Please review the MAP checkpoints attached; if these look good we'll route the DocuSign to your legal for a quick sign.
3) Vanessa will schedule the kickoff call for next Monday once we have the signed amendment.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/templates/secureai-amendment-8371
MAP & Amendment (attachments): amendment-terms.docx, proposed-MAP.pdf

If this works from your side, reply +1 and we'll send the DocuSign.

—
Grace O'Connor
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134
